name: Appliances Energy Prediction Dataset
description: The Appliances Energy Prediction dataset is an empirical benchmark from the UCI Machine Learning Repository for forecasting low-energy house appliance consumption. Collected over 4.5 months at 10-minute intervals (19,735 records), it incorporates indoor environmental parameters from a ZigBee sensor network (temperature and humidity across 9 rooms) combined with local weather conditions from a nearby meteorological station.
